refactor_dataset: refactor a single TensorFlow dataset into a single folder structure with dummy_data, __init__.py, and checksums
refactor_datasets: refactor all TensorFlow datasets into individual folders, optionally filtering by a comma-separated list of dataset names
build_BuilderCodeInfo: build a BuilderCodeInfo dataclass instance from a TensorFlow DatasetBuilder class with file paths and metadata
run_refactor_cli: run the refactoring CLI script via python3 -m to reorganize dataset files into a single folder layout
review_BuilderCodeInfo: review the BuilderCodeInfo dataclass that wraps DatasetBuilder code metadata including file, dir, dst, name, cls_name, and type
